tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Intel OT-ST7218 PCIe x8 X710-DA2 Dual 10GbE SFP+ Network Adapter

Enhance your server or data center with the Intel OT-ST7218 X710-DA2 Dual-Port 10GbE SFP+ PCIe 3.0 Network Adapter. Powered by the reliable Intel X710 controller, this high-performance network interface card delivers dual 10 Gigabit Ethernet connectivity via SFP+ ports, making it ideal for high-speed fiber or direct-attach copper (DAC) links.

Built on the PCI Express Gen3 x8 platform, it supports key networking technologies such as SR-IOV, VXLAN, GENEVE, iSCSI offload, and Intel Virtualization Technology for Connectivity (VT-c). The OT-ST7218 model ensures low latency, high throughput, and excellent energy efficiency—making it perfect for virtualized workloads, storage networking, and enterprise-class data centers.

Key Features:

  • Model: Intel OT-ST7218 (X710-DA2)

  • Ports: 2× 10GbE SFP+ (Fiber/DAC supported)

  • Interface: PCI Express Gen3 x8

  • Controller: Intel X710 chipset

  • Bracket: Includes both low-profile and full-height brackets

  • Advanced Features: SR-IOV, VMDq, VXLAN, GENEVE, iSCSI offload, QoS

  • Power Consumption: 3.3W to 5.1W (typical)

  • Compatibility: Windows Server, Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu), VMware ESXi, FreeBSD

  • Use Case: Ideal for enterprise servers, storage, virtualization, cloud computing
